name: Insulator Creek Falls
description:
A one-day bushwalk on Bambaroo Track to Insulator Creek canyon. Amazing giant trees and great rainforest scenes.  

Leader: Cherry Judge

Rated: Medium. Steep bush tracks, uneven footings, with some off-track creek walking and wet rocks. About 6+ hours bushwalking. 

Meeting: Will be emailed to those that RSVP 

Walk Description: 
The Bambaroo Track starts near the highway and climbs steeply up the range spurs to the top of the Paluma range. But today we will only go halfway up. The first hour is a hot steep road climb to get the heart pumping and sweat flowing. Then we enter the rainforest and the climb continues along a rainforest track, but less steep, to reach the start of the giant fig trees. These trees are amazing. 
 
After exploring one of the giant trees (there are at least 9 giant figs in the area, but will only visit a few), we continue to more fascinating trees of a different types. Then more track climbing up the range, to reach the Insulator Creek track. Steep rough track descending to the creek to amazing scenes. The terrain includes uneven footings, rock hopping, bush bashing, steep climbs, and some exposed ledges. 
 
The return journey is the same route but downhill most of the way. 
 
Full day walk. Estimate back at the carpark around 4 to 5 pm.
     
What to bring: 
Day pack, food/snacks for the day, water 2 to 3 lt minimum (refill from the creek at midday or carry 4 lt water for all day), long sleeve clothing and good rugged footwear (to protect from sun, scratches, stings, and bites), electrolytes, insect repellent (leeches, mozzies), hat, sunscreen, personal first aid kit (basic), and sunglasses. Also, head torch and whistle. 
 
If you are uncomfortable using creek water for drinking water refill (after treating suitably), then carry 4 lt min for the day, or more to suit your requirements. Note that the club recommends that any natural water sources must be suitably treated before consumption. 
 
Fees: non-members $5 
 
Must be over 18yrs to participate.    

To RSVP - Please fill this form - https://forms.gle/E6kieqv3LDr1F4R36

OR email the club at info@townsvillebushwalkingclub.com
 
If conditions on the day are unsuitable then the route and walk length may be changed at the leader’s discretion.

name: Mt Storth
description:
Leader: Molly Hoey 

Meeting Place & Time: Will be emailed to those that have RSVPd

Rated - Hard. off-track, 
 
Walk Description:

Mount Storth forms part of the Bowling Green Bay Park and reaches a height of 632 meters above sea level. This walk begins on Private property with the initial part winding through a series of creek beds and acts as a nice warm up before the climbing begins!
We will follow the ‘Traditional route’ and reach the summit via the prominent ridge line. Lunch at the top and then descend again.
This walk requires a high level of fitness. There is no track, the grass is very tall and the footing is loose. Those at the front of the walk often have to cut through Passion fruit vine and other shrub.

How long:
Full day walk. Estimate back at the car park around 5 pm.

RSVP: 
Must be over 18yrs to participate.
Fee: non-members & visitors - $5. TBWC Club members - Free.
You can become a TBWC member after 3 walks as a visitor. 

RSVP - Form Here - https://forms.gle/2obTd8WnjLfUaFNP7

Or Email the club - info@townsvillebushwalkingclub.com
